sections.overview: Thyreobaeus scutiger is a little-known spider in the family Linyphiidae, described from Madagascar.
sections.identification: The original description was based on a single female; a later taxonomic paper characterized it as a very small, dark spider with a dorsal scutum.
sections.habitat: The species is known from Madagascar, but the consulted catalogues do not give a more specific habitat or locality.
sections.diet: Its diet has not been documented in the sources consulted.
sections.behavior: No species-specific behavior is described in the sources consulted.
sections.reproduction: The original description was based on a female, but the sources consulted do not establish its reproductive biology.
sections.ecology: It is the type species of its genus; the available records are too sparse to characterize its ecological role.
sections.conservation: No conservation assessment or population trend was found in the consulted sources.
